title: FSLTL Live Traffic Broken in MSFS 2024? Fix stuck AI planes & missing configs!
description:
he brand-new FSLTL and Navigraph integration officially brought live traffic back to Microsoft Flight Simulator and Flight Simulator 2024, powered by real-time Flightradar24 data. The response has been huge, but anytime a major mod gets a ground-up overhaul, things are bound to get a little bit glitchy.

If you are running into frustrating snags—empty airports, missing config files, planes refusing to take off, or traffic getting stuck in an infinite pushback state—this deep-dive troubleshooting guide is for you. Crucially, many of these issues depend heavily on whether you are running the classic Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020 or the newer Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 platform.

In this video, we track down official insights from the support forums and FSLTL core developers like BirdmanRS to solve your exact questions. We cover how to locate your hidden configuration path, fix Windows system locale regional errors, and resolve the critical SimConnect ground traffic bug introduced by recent simulator base updates. You'll also learn how to use a community PowerShell script to safely automate a pushback override directly within your FSLTL base models pack.

We also look at the 1,000 SimObject limit, graphics settings tweaks to save your CPU performance, and why native simulator logic sometimes overrides real-world runway selections. Let's get your skies looking perfect and bustling once again!

01:10 - FSLTL: technical troubleshooting & installation fixes
